before.title: Follow your routine at Kairali
before.body: Attend your prescribed sessions, meals, suitable activity and rest. Keep your doctor informed about how you feel, and ask how your progress will be reviewed during the stay.

after.title: Your 14-night routine
after.body: Over the minimum 14-night admission, a typical day begins with group yoga at 06:30, as advised by your doctor, and a vegetarian breakfast. Your therapies are at 09:30 and 15:30, each followed by rest; therapy types, times and durations follow your doctor’s plan. Lunch is at 13:00, and a cooking demonstration, garden visit, workshop or lecture may be scheduled at 14:00. Guided meditation at 18:30 comes before dinner, and a farm, village or nature walk is arranged each week. Keep your doctor informed about how you feel, and ask how your progress will be reviewed during the stay.

before: If you are travelling from Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad or elsewhere in South India, start with the care you need and the time you can set aside. A residential Ayurveda programme gives you one place to follow your prescribed treatment and daily routine during your stay.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, your doctor assesses your health history and explains the proposed programme. Confirm the recommended stay and accommodation before arranging travel to Palakkad.
after: If you are travelling from Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad or elsewhere in South India, start with the care you need and the time you can set aside. A residential Ayurveda programme gives you one place to follow your prescribed treatment and daily routine during your stay.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, your doctor assesses your health history and explains the proposed programme. Confirm the recommended stay and accommodation before arranging travel to Palakkad.
Once you arrive, your days follow one routine in one place: therapies your doctor plans, meals from the hospital kitchen and a villa in the village gardens where you can rest between appointments.

before: Choosing a residential Ayurveda programme means trusting people you have not met yet. Before you commit, you need to know who will assess you, how your care is planned and what your stay involves.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital in Palakkad, Kerala, an Ayurvedic doctor reviews your medical history and examines you before prescribing treatment. Your programme is reviewed during your stay, and the next steps are discussed before discharge.

Once you are admitted, physicians review your care through the stay, and your villa in the village gardens gives you a quiet place to pause between appointments.

before: If you are looking into Ayurvedic cleansing, Panchakarma or rejuvenation, you will often see the terms used side by side. They can refer to different plans of care, and your medical history and assessment guide the choice.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital in Palakkad, Kerala, your doctor explains the preparation, prescribed procedures and recommended duration before treatment begins.

before: Ongoing discomfort can quietly reorganise your day around it. A useful first step is an honest conversation: tell the doctor where you feel discomfort, how long it has been present and which activities have become difficult.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital in Palakkad, your Ayurvedic doctor assesses your needs before prescribing care. Together you discuss realistic goals, the proposed therapies and how progress would be reviewed during a stay.

During a stay, your prescribed sessions and physician reviews share one daily routine, with time between sessions to rest in your villa and move at a pace that suits you.

before: When you compare Panchakarma packages, it is natural to look at length and cost first. At Kairali, the programme is not picked from a list: your doctor first assesses whether Panchakarma is suitable, which procedures may be considered and how long you would need.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital in Palakkad, Kerala. The published Panchakarma programme is a 14–21 night stay; discuss the time you can set aside and confirm the recommended duration before arranging travel.

before: If you are looking for Ayurvedic weight loss treatment, the first conversation is about more than a target weight. Tell the doctor about your health history, current medicines, previous approaches and the routines you find difficult to maintain.

Kairali’s Weight Management & Metabolism Therapy is planned after assessment at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital in Palakkad, Kerala. Your doctor discusses the proposed care and reviews progress during the stay. Weight change and timing vary from person to person.
